scientific_justification.frozen_program_007_rule: Every returned corporate action must have a non-empty CUSIP.
scientific_justification.provider_contract: Processed actions may be returned by data_quality=complete even when CUSIP, ISIN, ex-date, or another completeness field is missing.
scientific_justification.retained_evidence: The response maps all rows to public-ledger identities, contains all five exact split controls, and has no deeper source incompatibility beyond optional metadata and non-global response order.

fresh_request.purpose: Test the never-executed CUSIP filter, endpoint access, positive-control recovery, stable cross-filter event identity, public-ledger reconciliation, discrepancy detection, and corrected optional-identifier handling.
fresh_request.why_one_chain_is_sufficient: It is the only frozen identity-filter behavior Program 007 did not execute. The exposed symbol response supplies the regression and cross-filter baseline; a second symbol request would repeat observed source behavior without adding a distinct falsifiable question.

corrected_metadata_contract.request_identity: The immutable CUSIP intent proves which thirteen public-ledger identities were queried; a response row need not echo CUSIP when its symbol maps unambiguously.
corrected_metadata_contract.response_identity: Every event must map to exactly one canonical public-ledger security through a known symbol, a matching CUSIP, or both.
corrected_metadata_contract.public_ledger_priority: The public ledger remains canonical. Alpaca cannot override symbol, CUSIP, issuer, continuity, or action terms silently.

cusip.empty_or_absent: Allowed only with an unambiguous public-ledger symbol mapping.

provider_event_id.cross_filter_role: All overlapping IDs must have the same core content; all five positive controls must retain the exposed symbol-response IDs.

economic_dates.cash_dividend: ex_date when present, but a non-unit cash dividend cannot fail share-unit continuity solely for missing optional identity metadata
economic_dates.name_change: No provider economic-date field is invented; same-symbol same-CUSIP or missing-CUSIP metadata may be classified as an identity no-break, while any change or ambiguity fails for review.

corrected_metadata_contract.ordering: Validate every process_date against the request interval and sort canonical events after complete pagination; do not require global provider order.
corrected_metadata_contract.source_finality: No negative-event completeness claim; creation lag remains unbounded.

qualification_gates: exact reviewed request identity and limits
HTTP 200 and bounded raw-first create-only persistence
known response arrays and fields only
valid nonrepeating pagination ending in null next_page_token
every event maps to exactly one public-ledger security
no conflicting non-empty ISIN for one provider event ID
all in-scope relevant events have usable documented economic dates and terms
all five exact positive controls are present
all five control event IDs and core content reconcile with exposed Program 007 evidence
all other overlapping provider event IDs have matching core content
no unsupported in-scope unit or identity event
no byte, request, response, page, host, path, redirect, or retry breach

allowed_inventory_differences.exposed_only_non_unit_events: Allowed because a CUSIP filter need not recover rows whose provider CUSIP metadata is absent.
allowed_inventory_differences.fresh_only_events: Allowed only after full corrected-contract validation because provider creation lag is unbounded.
allowed_inventory_differences.relevant_exposed_events: All five controls must appear and reconcile; no exposed relevant control may disappear.

exact_next_step: Obtain a finding-free review and merge this non-authorizing proposal. Any future execution requires a separate exact Program 008 one-use authority proposal, another review, and a new explicit user authorization. Do not execute from this artifact.
